title: wet paint
summary: The little Claude mascot walks through five unfinished paintings with a brush and adds what each one is missing, then hangs them on a wall and paints himself. Drawn live in canvas 2D.
medium: animated short film, canvas 2d + web audio, single file

specs.length: 60 seconds (24 bars at 96 bpm), then it loops
specs.scenes: 6, ten seconds each, joined by brush-stroke wipes
specs.styles: pencil sketch and watercolour, ink on rice paper, gouache night, thick short strokes, flat top-down pond, a gallery wall
specs.controls: click for sound, then click or space to pause, ← → skip 5 s, m mutes
specs.assets: none, every picture is drawn by code when the page loads
specs.inspired by: the one-minute canvas film posted by @chetaslua on X (the format only: the mascot finishing paintings in pure JS; the six paintings here are new)
